slots.result: noise erased (lines restored to 5, other cells to 0); every crossing of a separator row and separator column takes the noise colour

reading: Each pair of same-colour marker cells defines a rectangle snapped to the lattice gap lines; its outline is drawn in that colour and the centres of the enclosed squares are filled with it.

slots.result: the smallest gap-line rectangle containing both markers is outlined in their colour, and the centre of every lattice square inside it gets that colour
